evidence.quote: Requests authenticated with these tokens are considered as "Personal API" and will have the same level of access as the user that generated the token has.
a standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, including the PKCE extension for client-side only authentication

Personal API access is available on Starter, Business, and Enterprise plans. Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate. The Free plan does not include API access.
All authenticated requests require an Authorization: Bearer TOKEN header plus a Public-Api-Version: 2025-10-31 header.
Grain's MCP server is officially supported by us and aligns with our existing security practices, follows the MCP specification exactly, and uses industry-standard OAuth authentication and HTTPS.
The Free plan does not include API access.

result.notes: Grain has a documented REST API (api.grain.com) with Personal Access Tokens, Workspace Access Tokens, and an OAuth2 Authorization Code (+PKCE) flow for third-party apps; all requests use Bearer auth. API access requires a paid Starter/Business/Enterprise plan (Free plan excluded), so credentials aren't self-serve-free. Grain also publishes an official MCP server (developers.grain.com/mcp) using OAuth, with most tools available across plans except Deals/Sales Coaching tools gated to Business+. Older docs.grain.inc site returned 404, suggesting it's deprecated in favor of developers.grain.com.
result.one_liner: Grain is an AI meeting notetaker/recorder that offers a REST API and official MCP server for reading meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI notes, gated behind paid subscription plans.
